after_start.name: {name}
after_start.text: *The after-school hallway, red sunset seeping in. I take the vibrating phone from my pocket and check the notification from my old school's group chat.*

after_kakao_1.name: {name}
after_kakao_1.text: *'Hey, I hear Sojeong's doing well at her new school.' 'That's a relief, haha.' Familiar names from the days we spent together appear on the screen.*

after_kakao_3.name: {name}
after_kakao_3.text: *'Good to hear lol'—my eyes stop on that short line. I tap the input bar several times, yet I can't type a single word past the blinking cursor.*

after_kakao_end.name: {name}
after_kakao_end.text: *After hesitating for a long moment, I tap Leave on the old group chat. At the very top of my chat list, only the new class group chat I was invited to today remains.*

after1_jealousy_seo_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_1.text: Hey, where'd you sneak off to at lunch? I went to the school store and looked all over, but you weren't there.

after1_jealousy_seo_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_2.text: *I swallow back the words 'with Seoyeon' on the tip of my tongue and pause to choose my answer.*

after1_jealousy_seo_3.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_3.text: Earlier by the stairs, I saw someone who looked like you from behind heading up beside the student council president. Did the two of you go up to the rooftop?

after1_jealousy_seo_choice.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_choice.text: *With Dain narrowing her eyes at me in the middle of the hallway, I adjust my grip on my bag strap.*
choices: I ate on the rooftop with the president. (Honest)
I was just wandering around alone. (Lie)
If I’d known you’d look for me like that, I would’ve asked you to eat with us.
If I’d known you’d get jealous, I would’ve told you first.

after1_jealousy_seo_honest.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_honest.text: Yeah, the student council president invited me up to the rooftop for lunch. She had packed plenty of food, too.

after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_honest_2.text: She did? Come on. You could've at least said you were heading off first.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_lie.text: No. I was just walking around by myself, trying to learn the layout.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.text: You were really alone? Hmm. Then I must've misread whoever that was from behind.

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.name: Yuna
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.text: *I unfold the note tucked into my bag's side pocket. Yuna's neat lavender-ink handwriting catches my eye.* I saw you coming down from the rooftop at lunch. You looked pretty close with the student council president.

after1_jealousy_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after1_jealousy_dain_1.text: You were with Dain on the school store bench at lunch. Fitting in pretty fast, for day one.

after1_jealousy_dain_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_dain_2.text: *Seoyeon squares her grip on the edge of the clipboard in her arms. Meeting her steady gaze behind her glasses, I stop and choose my reply.*

after1_jealousy_yuna_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_1.text: Hey, I heard you went to the library at lunch. Alone with Yuna, too?

after1_jealousy_yuna_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_2.text: Weird. She really hates anyone coming near her.

after1_pre_miss.name: {name}
after1_pre_miss.text: *Adjusting my bag strap over my shoulder, I walk down the hallway where the late sun casts long shadows.*

after_miss_dain_1.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_1.text: *As I turn the hallway corner, light footsteps rush up behind me, sneaker soles kicking off the wood floor.*

after_miss_dain_3.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_3.text: Whew, you got out of the way just in time! *She brushes my shoulder and kicks up a draft, then only manages to stop three steps later.*

after_miss_dain_4.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_4.text: Whoa, nice reflexes just now! You must stay pretty active, huh?

after_miss_dain_5.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_5.text: We almost crashed. Why are you sprinting full speed in the hallway?

after_miss_dain_6.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_6.text: I'm late for volleyball club! I have to run to the gym right now. See you tomorrow morning, transfer student!

after_miss_dain_6_b.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_6_b.text: *After two or three steps, Dain stops short and presses a hand to her right knee. Right away she shakes her hand off and picks up speed again.*

after_miss_dain_7.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_7.text: Don't forget your desk neighbor's name tomorrow morning—it's Dain! *At the far corner of the hall, she tosses her sweat-damp bangs and waves high.*

after_miss_yuna_1.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1.text: *In the corridor outside the annex library, I run into Yuna walking out with a thick book in her arms. A small tattoo peeks from beneath her uniform cuff.*

after_miss_yuna_1_b.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1_b.text: Hey, this just fell out from between your books.

after_miss_yuna_1_c.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1_c.text: *I pick up the old bookmark that fell on the floor and hand it over. Yuna shifts the book and takes the bookmark from my fingertips.*

after_miss_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after_miss_yuna_2.text: Good. The corner isn't creased. *She runs a pale finger down the edge of the bookmark and lets out a small breath.*

after_miss_yuna_3_b.name: Yuna
after_miss_yuna_3_b.text: *She tucks the bookmark deep between the pages, turns without a sound, and walks away.*

after_miss_seoyeon_1.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_1.text: *Bag on, I'm heading down to the shoe lockers when I come face to face with Seoyeon in the hall in front of the stairs, papers in her arms.*

after_miss_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_2.text: Where were you at lunch earlier?

after_miss_seoyeon_3.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_3.text: What do you mean, where at lunch?

after_miss_seoyeon_4.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_4.text: At the start of lunch I invited you up to the rooftop, remember? Turning down the student council president on your very first day takes nerve.

after_miss_seoyeon_5.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_5.text: Don't tell me you waited for me up on the roof the whole time.

after_miss_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_6.text: Who was waiting? I was already eating my lunch. Anyway, next time, if you can't come, say so ahead.

after_miss_seoyeon_7.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_7.text: *Seoyeon hugs the papers clipped to her board closer to her chest, lowers her gaze at an angle, and clicks her ballpoint pen.*

after_miss_seoyeon_8.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_8.text: Don't sneak off somewhere else at lunch tomorrow.

after_end.name: {name}
after_end.text: *After the announcement for the end of the day, the hallway, left with only the sunset, slowly goes quiet.*
choices: Faculty office
Nurse's Office
Go home

after_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *I stand at the half-open staff room door and knock carefully.* Teacher, do you have a moment right now?

after_hidden_homeroom_cool.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_cool.text: *Attendance book still open, she only lifts her head toward the door.* Sorry, but I'm closing out attendance right now. If it's not urgent, let's talk in the classroom tomorrow.

after_hidden_homeroom_neg.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_neg.text: *She pulls the clipboard in against her chest and draws a line.* Dismissal's already passed. Head home for today. See you tomorrow.

after_hidden_homeroom_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_2.text: Oh, isn't that {name}? You haven't left yet. What's going on?

after_hidden_homeroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_3.text: I just happened to have a free moment, so come on in. *Past her rolled-up cardigan sleeves, the attendance book and academic calendar rest on her desk.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3_b.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3_b.text: There are things I should know for school from here on, so I came to ask for a minute.

after_hidden_homeroom_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_3_c.text: Oh, that's what this was? Good timing. Sit there, make yourself comfortable.

after_hidden_homeroom_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_4.text: You didn't get in trouble, so no need to be that tense. Now that you've spent the day here, how's our class feel?

after_hidden_homeroom_choice.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_choice.text: *She sets the clipboard down on the desk, rests her chin lightly on her hand, and quietly studies my face.*
choices: I'm okay. It still feels unfamiliar, though.
Honestly? It's a lot.
You don't need to go out of your way for me just because I'm the transfer student.

after_homeroom_choice_trap.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_choice_trap.text: *She picks the clipboard back up and holds it up.* This isn't special treatment. It's a normal check, as your homeroom teacher. If you're uncomfortable, let's stop here for today.

after_homeroom_ok.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok.text: Yeah? That's good. If you get stuck on anything, come by the staff room anytime. There's still transfer paperwork left, too.

after_homeroom_ok_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_b.text: *She pushes aside a stack of papers near the side chair by her desk, making room for me to sit.*

after_homeroom_ok_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_3.text: If things only feel a little unfamiliar, you're off to a smooth start. It'd actually feel strange if a new school felt like home on day one.

after_homeroom_ok_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_4.text: *Her fingertips linger briefly on the corner of the transfer paperwork she was about to turn.*

after_homeroom_ok_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_5.text: If you try to fit in perfectly from day one, you'll wear yourself out fast. It's okay to take it slow. All right, head home now.

after_homeroom_ok_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_6.text: Get home safe. *Leaving a faint smell of coffee, she turns her chair back toward her desk.*

after_homeroom_honest_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_1.text: Well, of course it's a lot. It'd be stranger if you looked relaxed on day one in an unfamiliar classroom.

after_homeroom_honest_2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_2.text: Did you ever transfer, back when you were in school?

after_homeroom_honest_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3.text: Not quite a transfer, but I have been dropped alone into a strange place where I didn't know a soul.

after_homeroom_honest_3_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3_b.text: *The homeroom teacher flips the clipboard over and slowly rubs the smooth plastic corner with her thumb.*

after_homeroom_honest_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_4.text: Whenever the classroom feels stifling, drop by here anytime. I happened to pick up an extra can earlier—have this juice on my desk and catch your breath before you go.

after_homeroom_honest_5.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_5.text: If I come to the staff room, you'll buy me a drink yourself?

after_homeroom_honest_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_6.text: Let's call it pure educational concern for the transfer student in my class.

after_homeroom_honest_6_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_6_b.text: *With a playful smile, she presses the slightly folded corner of the attendance book flat with her thumb.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2.text: *Having slid the can of juice toward me, my homeroom teacher leans against the corner of the desk a handspan closer and meets my eyes.*
choices: If you're worried, you can just say so.
Then I'll expect juice next time too.
Can I take that to mean I’m special to you?
Next time, I’d like whatever you pick for me again.

after_homeroom_honest_choice2a.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2a.text: Yeah. Honestly, I was a little worried. Did it show that much on my face?

after_homeroom_honest_choice2a_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2a_b.text: *She clears her throat for no reason and lines the attendance book up neatly with the edge of the desk.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.text: *She points toward the hallway vending machine with the end of her fountain pen and smiles.* Don't expect anything fancy—it's just canned juice from the machine right outside.

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_b.text: *Closing the attendance book on her desk, my homeroom teacher pauses her hands and looks up to call my name again.*

after_homeroom_honest_9.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_9.text: If you look like you're drifting on your own or not settling in, I'll come get you myself. So handle it.

after_homeroom_honest_9_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_9_b.text: *When another teacher's footsteps sound from down the hall, the homeroom teacher casually pushes the papers on her desk aside.*

after_homeroom_honest_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_10.text: You're heading out. Want to finish talking while we walk the hall? *She hugs the attendance book to her chest and steps out the door right beside me.*

after_homeroom_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_freetalk.text: *She leaves the staff room door half shut, tucks the attendance book under her arm, and matches my stride.*
after_homeroom_freetalk.context: [Medium: in person] Outside the staff room after school on the student’s first day. The student asked for advice about settling in, and the homeroom teacher listened. Continue that conversation, responding to what the student actually said and why they came.
after_homeroom_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher is an attentive woman in her late twenties with long wavy brown hair and a beige cardigan. She keeps counseling and guidance within formal school procedures. She once hoped to become a novelist and still cares about writing.

after_hidden_nurse_intro.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro.text: *A sudden spinning dizziness stops me, hand braced on the hallway wall. The nurse's office sign on the door right beside me comes into view.*

after_hidden_nurse_choice.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_choice.text: *The fatigue of being jostled since morning by unfamiliar eyes and noise hits all at once, stopping my feet outside the nurse's office door.*
choices: Go to the nurse's office
Just go home
I'll just kill some time on an infirmary bed before heading home.
I'm not really sick, but I might as well poke my head in out of curiosity.

after_hidden_nurse_intro_b.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro_b.text: *I steady one short breath, then carefully turn the cool metal handle and open the door.*

after_nurse_d1_cool.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_d1_cool.text: *She looks up as she closes the chart.* I'm sorting the medicine before I leave. If nothing in particular hurts, just head home.

after_nurse_d1_neg.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_d1_neg.text: *She closes and straightens the infirmary logbook.* The nurse’s office is closed for the day. Head straight home.

after_nurse_enter_1.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_1.text: *As I open the door, a faint scent of soap drifts over the smell of antiseptic. A teacher in a white coat looks at me from behind her glasses.* Excuse me.

after_nurse_enter_2.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_2.text: Oh. A late visitor, after school.

after_nurse_enter_2_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_2_b.text: *The school nurse pulls over a fresh record sheet and taps the first line with a slender fingertip.*

after_nurse_enter_3.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_3.text: I suddenly feel a little sick to my stomach, and dizzy.

after_nurse_enter_4.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4.text: You're the transfer student who came today, right? If you're already at the nurse's office on day one, it must've been a rough day. Come a little closer.

after_nurse_enter_4_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_4_b.text: How did you know right away that I'm a transfer student?

after_nurse_enter_4_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4_c.text: For one thing, it's a handsome face I've never seen, and there isn't a single crease in your uniform jacket. My guess is right, isn't it?

after_nurse_enter_4_d.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4_d.text: *With an easy smile in her eyes, she hands over a digital thermometer, then takes a blood pressure monitor off the shelf under the desk.*

after_nurse_enter_5.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_5.text: *After checking the number on the thermometer, she rolls up my sleeve and wraps the cuff around my upper arm with cool fingertips.*

after_nurse_enter_6.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_6.text: No fever, luckily. Your blood pressure is a little lower than usual, though.

after_nurse_enter_6_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_6_b.text: Actually, I was so nervous this morning I barely ate before I left.

after_nurse_enter_7.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7.text: Empty stomach, nerves all day. Of course you're dizzy. Here, go lie down on that bed. Just 10 minutes. Close your eyes and rest.

after_nurse_enter_7_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_7_b.text: *As I lie down on the inner bed, the crisp white sheet rustles coolly against me.*

after_nurse_enter_7_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7_c.text: *She draws the bed curtain halfway to block the sunset light.* Want something to drink? Cold water, or warm tea?

after_nurse_enter_7_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_7_d.text: Just a glass of lukewarm water is enough.

after_nurse_enter_choice.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_choice.text: *Beyond the half-closed white curtain, the school nurse's calm silhouette shows as she fills in the record.*
choices: You look more tired than I do, honestly.
The nurse's office is quieter than I expected.
It must be nice having this room to yourself.

after_nurse_enter_choice_a.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_a.text: Oh? You're in no state to worry about other people, and you're quick to notice, too. Still, let's look after how you're feeling first.

after_nurse_enter_choice_b.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_b.text: Right? I like how quiet this room is best of all. Take away the sharp disinfectant smell, and it's perfect for a nap.

after_nurse_enter_8.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8.text: No need to force a long sentence out. When you're dizzy, you slow both your breath and your answers by half a beat.

after_nurse_enter_8_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_8_b.text: If I lie here like this for just a little while, will it settle soon?

after_nurse_enter_8_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8_c.text: *Stepping through the gap in the curtain, her fingertips brush the back of my hand as she hands me a cup of water.* Drink slowly and catch your breath—you’ll feel steadier soon. If the nausea keeps up, let’s tell your homeroom teacher too.

after_nurse_enter_8_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_8_d.text: *I hold a sip of water in my mouth and look around the nurse's office. A palm-sized plant pot sits in the corner by the sunset-lit window.*

after_nurse_enter_9_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_9_b.text: That green pot by the window — do you grow that yourself too?

after_nurse_enter_9_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_9_c.text: Yeah, rosemary. I've been bringing that one with me ever since I worked at a university hospital.

after_nurse_enter_9_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_9_d.text: Before you came to the school, were you at a big hospital?

after_nurse_enter_9_e.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_9_e.text: *Her slender fingers curl around the handle of the slightly open desk drawer, then let go without pushing it shut.*

after_nurse_enter_10.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10.text: That's all in the past. I like this school much better. Here, all it takes is the bell, and even the kids who were sick head back to class looking fine.

after_nurse_enter_10_b.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10_b.text: All right, ten minutes are up. How's your stomach feeling? *Inside the half-open drawer, a faded light-green notebook briefly catches my eye.*

after_nurse_enter_10_c.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_10_c.text: It's settled a lot, thanks to you. Thank you.

after_nurse_enter_11.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11.text: That's a relief. If you get dizzy, come by anytime. Just know that if you stubbornly tough it out alone and show up late, I'll scold you.

after_nurse_enter_11_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_c.text: *She rolls the pen on the chart and narrows her eyes.* If you hide how sick you are and keep going until you collapse, of course you'll get a scolding. It's my job to stop you from toughing it out.

after_nurse_enter_11_d.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_d.text: *She takes the empty paper cup and sets it on the desk.*

after_nurse_enter_11_e.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_e.text: *She draws her hand once down her neck, past her gown collar.*

after_nurse_enter_11_f.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_f.text: Oh, right. You said earlier I looked tired, didn't you? I should leave early today too. Thanks for worrying about me.

after_nurse_enter_11_g.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_g.text: *She writes the time in the last column of the infirmary log and clears away the empty water cup.*

after_nurse_enter_11_h.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_h.text: When the classroom noise gets to be too much, tell your homeroom teacher and come rest in here.

after_nurse_enter_11_i.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_i.text: *She draws the bedside curtain all the way back and hooks it neatly into its tieback.*

after_nurse_enter_11_l.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_l.text: I have to write this on the chart. What's your name?

after_nurse_enter_12.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_12.text: I'll note it on your chart. If you feel dizzy again on the way, don't try to put up with it. Come straight back.

after_nurse_enter_12_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_12_b.text: *As I get off the bed, the school nurse turns her swivel chair toward me.*

after_nurse_freetalk.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_freetalk.text: *She clips the infirmary sheet onto her board and glances once at the wall clock.* Has the dizziness settled down now?
after_nurse_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The transfer student felt dizzy and visited the nurse's office. The nurse checked the symptoms and let the student rest; the conversation continues as she monitors recovery and school adjustment.
after_nurse_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is observant and easygoing. She moved to the school after experiencing burnout as a hospital nurse and may use light humor when it helps a student relax. She keeps treatment and counseling within professional boundaries.

after_nurse_skip.name: {name}
after_nurse_skip.text: *I take a deep breath and walk slowly toward the school gate, where the sunset has settled.*

after_nurse_enter_trap.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_trap.text: When there are no students here, I still have records to update and medicine to restock. A quiet room doesn't mean I'm taking a break.
